_about: Hand-written content of the dashboard work board: Hebrew titles for discovered resources, the first board's frames and what goes in each, the starter cards, the prompts and the built-in templates. catalog.py reads this file with lumebook.json, shared/facts.json, media/README.md and shared/brand, and writes seed.js. The board uses the seed only to build a board that does not exist yet (first open, or 'reset' with a backup); refreshes never move or rename cards on a saved board. Hebrew follows creators/creator-research/src/hebrew-rules.md; no em dashes.
